eligibility: Evidence-bound include silver with unchanged source/tests/raw artifacts; no unresolved exact or semantic duplicate

real_train_class_support.rule: Derive qualifying classes from all curated real train records before any research fit/prediction; select train only from those classes. Never relabel a sparse class. Preserve sparse-class records outside the final selection with explicit reasons.
real_train_class_support.heldout_rule: Do not filter validation/test by train class support. Report unseen classes and per-class support/metrics, including errors. The diagnosis output taxonomy stays unchanged.

ordering: Within each frozen role, sort eligible real source_case_id lexicographically and take the role target. Never rank by retrieval coverage, model prediction or diagnosis performance. Retain all unselected records and selection reasons.

synthetic.target: Equal to actual selected real train count
synthetic.role: train only, original repository roles unchanged
synthetic.class_scope: Same qualifying real-train classes, with quality/evidence review and exact/semantic family adjudication before selection
synthetic.ordering: Sort eligible generation_run and attempt_index; take the required number after duplicate adjudication

boundaries: This implements the existing minimum10-per-learned-class gate; it does not reduce the250-real or matched-synthetic gates.
If targets cannot be met under these rules and original time/storage/request caps, report the deficit and leave SFT gated.
Gold remains pending. Actor remains unknown for real reconstructions. No repository role or existing assessment is rewritten.
